description: Keeps the SheepOS pipeline in sync with kairos-init, the Kairos Factory Action, AuroraBoot, Ubuntu and k3s via the Mend Renovate app (installed on the New-Pluto org). GitHub Dependabot *alerts* stay enabled in repo settings for security advisories; Dependabot version PRs are retired (.github/dependabot.yml deleted). Built-in managers cover Dockerfile FROM lines and workflow `uses:` refs; the custom managers below cover pins that live in ARG defaults / workflow inputs. platformAutomerge is off (mirrors sheepnet): Renovate merges automerge-eligible PRs itself once every check on the PR is green — build.yaml runs on every pull_request with no paths filter, so checks are always present. Automerge is safe here because merging publishes nothing: releases only ship on a manual v* tag, and sheepnet's SUC rollout gates what reaches nodes.

customManagers.description: Version pins annotated with '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' (k3s in images/Dockerfile, auroraboot_version in workflows)
Container image pins annotated with '# renovate: docker-image' (Ubuntu base in the images/Dockerfile ARG default — the single source of truth; build.yaml reads the ARG at runtime)

packageRules.description: k3s tags carry +k3sN build metadata; coerce for ordering. NEVER automerge: bumps must respect sheepnet's Cilium compatibility floor and ideally match what the cluster is being upgraded to.

Only LTS tags (.04 of even years), never interim releases like 26.10 or 27.04. Renovate forbids allowedVersions and matchUpdateTypes in the same rule, hence the split. Scoped to the docker datasource so the rule never touches the github-runners 'ubuntu' dep extracted from runs-on: lines.
New Ubuntu releases change the userland — opt in deliberately instead of auto-PRing.
Std actions + the factory reusable-workflow ref: non-major bumps and digest pins/refreshes automerge on green CI. Majors (e.g. factory v1→v2, which may change inputs) stay human.
Build-chain tooling: every PR is validated end-to-end by the build matrix (image + ISO, both arches) before Renovate merges, and a merge publishes nothing until a release tag. Majors stay human.
